brief: Is the common base of the neural classes, which carries what they share: access to the vendored ggml backend.
detail: It is not meant to be built for its own sake; stzNeuralEngine and stzNeuralModel derive from it. It answers two questions every neural class depends on: which ggml build is linked, and whether the backend computes. The data-returning shortcuts StzGgmlVersion() and StzGgmlReady() do the same without an object.
